title: Sales Service Coordinator
description:
Your next step in logistics, customer service, and global trade
As a Sales Service Coordinator in the Basic Materials Division, you will be part of our international operations team, supporting order flows and customer deliveries across in North America. This is a fully remote position based in Mexico, preferably in Mexico City Area.
What you’ll do
You will help ensure that shipments move efficiently from warehouse or port to customer in US and Canada, while keeping all parties informed and aligned. Your responsibilities include:

• Manage the full order-handling process including import, shipment coordination, documentation, and deliveries

• Key in orders into our ERP system and update accordingly

• Communicating daily with internal teams, customers, suppliers, and logistics partners

• Tracking shipments and ensuring timelines are met

• Supporting invoice handling and administrative tasks

• Proactively solving issues and keeping stakeholders updated

Who we’re looking for
You are a structured, service-minded professional who enjoys coordination, problem-solving, and working independently in a remote set up.
The ideal candidate has:

• 3-5 years’ experience in logistics (trucking, warehouses, drumming)

• Experience working in international trading and domestic sales, in a global organization

• Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written

• Customer-focused, with the ability to prioritize and deliver under tight deadlines

• Curious and eager to learn new things

• Comfortable working virtually from home utilizing Teams and other technology, ensuring open and timely communication with colleagues and customers

• Proficient in all MS Office applications including Word, Excel, Teams

Additional assets

• CITT or education in supply chain

• Experience working with chemical commodity products

• Familiar with Hazmat, GHS, EPA, FDA is a plus

As part of our recruitment process, we may conduct background checks. We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

- Collaborate with the Global SE Onboarding team to shape and continuously refine the everboarding program based on the segment's needs

REQUIRED SKILLS:

- A minimum of 10 years of related experience with a focus on enterprise software, solution engineering, and enablement in the data space

- Bachelor’s degree

- Exceptional business, technical, and sales acumen

- Should have deep technical expertise in skills database OLAP/OLTP, SQL, and/or Python

- Snowflake experience, SnowPro Core, and/or SnowPro Advanced is a plus

- Data science or Spark experience is a plus

- Experienced in designing, building, and delivering enablement programs

- Ability to lead through influence

- Ability to establish sponsorship and secure support from a diverse group of internal stakeholders and cross-functional partners to successfully deliver programs

- Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple projects, while meeting deadlines and producing quality deliverables

- Highly organized with excellent communication skills (including presentation skills)

- Experience working in a fast-changing environment that requires strategic thinking, resourcefulness, agility, results-oriented decision-making, and commitment to excellence

description:

Hamburg, Berlin, hybrid

Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) - Bremen
description:
Salonkee kommt nach Bremen und sucht die erste Person im Vertrieb. Bei uns bekommst du ein strukturiertes Onboarding, dein eigenes Gebiet, kurze Sales-Cycles und ein Team, das dich weiterentwickelt.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare erste Erfahrung im Outbound-Sales inkl. Kaltakquise.

- Hohe Selbststeuerung und Eigenverantwortung - du gehörst zu den ersten Teammitgliedern vor Ort.

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Eine Führungskraft und Kolleg:innen, die dich jederzeit unterstützen.

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist/Shopify Specialist
description:
Position: Digital Marketing Specialist / Shopify Specialist
Salary: $1,800 - $2,500 AUD a month maximum
Working Hours & Conditions: Australian Hours
Holidays: Australian Public Holidays
About the Company
The company is a lifestyle and retail business offering a carefully curated collection of fashion, beauty, homewares, accessories, children’s products, and lifestyle goods from brands selected for their quality, purpose, sustainability, and thoughtful design.
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist / Shopify Specialist to take ownership of company's online store and help drive stronger e-commerce performance.
The primary focus of this role is Shopify and conversion rate optimization - improving the website experience, merchandising, product presentation, SEO, and customer journey to turn more existing website traffic into customers.
Alongside Shopify, the successful candidate will support SEO, Klaviyo/email marketing, marketing automation, social media, graphic design, and digital advertising. As website conversion performance improves, paid advertising across platforms such as Meta and Google can become a greater focus for driving scalable online growth.
This is a hands-on role for someone who understands that successful e-commerce marketing is not simply about generating traffic. You should be comfortable analyzing the complete customer journey, identifying where customers are dropping off, and implementing practical improvements that increase conversion, engagement, repeat purchases, and online revenue.
Key Responsibilities
Shopify & E-Commerce Management (Primary Focus)

• Take day-to-day ownership of the Shopify website

• Maintain and optimize product pages, collections, navigation, menus, and site content

• Ensure product information, imagery, descriptions, pricing, and promotional content are accurate and well presented

• Improve product merchandising and collection structure to make products easier to discover

• Review the customer journey from landing page through to checkout

• Identify website issues that may be limiting conversion

• Implement improvements to usability, navigation, product discovery, and overall shopping experience

• Coordinate website promotions, seasonal campaigns, product launches, and sales

• Ensure the online store remains current, visually consistent, and aligned with the brand

• Monitor website performance and recommend ongoing improvements

Conversion Rate Optimisation

• Analyse website behaviour and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates

• Review key landing pages, product pages, collection pages, and checkout journeys

• Identify points of friction or customer drop-off

• Recommend and implement practical CRO improvements

• Test improvements to page layouts, calls-to-action, messaging, offers, and merchandising

• Improve mobile shopping experience and website usability

• Monitor conversion performance and report on improvements over time

• Use data rather than assumptions to guide website changes

SEO & Organic Website Growth

• Improve on-page SEO across the Shopify website

• Optimise product and collection titles, descriptions, metadata, headings, and URLs

• Conduct keyword research relevant to company’s products and customers

• Identify opportunities to improve organic visibility for important product categories

• Optimise new and existing website content for search

• Monitor organic traffic, rankings, and website performance

• Identify and resolve basic technical SEO issues where possible

• Ensure SEO best practices are incorporated into ongoing Shopify management

Klaviyo, Email Marketing & Automation

• Manage and optimise Klaviyo email marketing activity

• Build and improve automated customer flows

• Develop campaigns supporting product launches, promotions, seasonal activity, and customer retention

• Improve key automations such as welcome, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, and re-engagement flows

title: Salesforce Product Manager
description:
About the Role
StationMD is seeking a Salesforce Product Manager to own and advance our Salesforce ecosystem for a national telehealth organization serving individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities (I/DD).
In this role, you will act as the Salesforce Product Owner, driving long-term strategy, roadmap planning, stakeholder alignment, platform optimization, and user support. You will work closely with internal Salesforce leads, business units, executive stakeholders, consultants, data teams, technology leaders, and end users to ensure the Salesforce configuration meets business needs and supports company goals.
The ideal candidate balances high-level strategic vision with hands-on Salesforce administration and technical execution. This role is well suited for someone who can translate complex business needs into actionable user stories, strengthen platform adoption, support users, and maximize StationMD ’s investment in Salesforce, including Health Cloud.
About StationMD

At StationMD , we are transforming access to healthcare for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities (I/DD). Every StationMD clinician is board-certified and specially trained to care for this unique and often underserved population.
Our clinicians deliver compassionate, high-quality telemedicine services 24/7, addressing both urgent and non-urgent medical needs. Through timely, specialized virtual care, we help reduce unnecessary emergency room visits, improve overall health outcomes, and ensure individuals with I/DD receive the thoughtful, expert attention they deserve.
In addition to on-demand urgent care, StationMD provides scheduled primary care and psychiatry services via telemedicine. Together, this comprehensive suite of services expands access to quality healthcare while significantly lowering avoidable medical costs.
Responsibilities - Salesforce Product Manager
Product Ownership & Platform Management

• Define the long-term Salesforce product roadmap aligned with overall business goals

• Act as the primary liaison between business units, executive stakeholders, consultants, and technical teams

• Gather, prioritize, and translate complex business requirements into actionable user stories

• Enable end users to effectively use Salesforce to help meet company goals

• Lead release management processes, governance frameworks, and change management strategies

• Stay current with Salesforce releases, new features, and best practices to continuously improve system performance and meet business needs

Salesforce Administration & Execution

• Triage Salesforce support tickets

• Train users on Salesforce features and functionality

• Serve as company subject matter expert on Salesforce functionality

• Handle user provisioning, deactivation, and access management across the organization

• In conjunction with internal Salesforce and data leads, design, develop, and maintain reports and dashboards

• Work with security operations leads to ensure the platform adheres to best practices related to privacy and security

• Work with Technology leads to participate in data migration, data mapping, and basic integration maintenance activities

• Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications - Salesforce Product Manager

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or equivalent experience

• 2+ years of experience in a Product Owner, Platform Manager, or Business Analyst role

• 3-5+ years of hands-on Salesforce Administration experience, especially Health Cloud

• Experience with Sales Cloud, Data Cloud, and Marketing Cloud is a plus

• Proven track record of managing a Salesforce roadmap and leading cross-functional projects

• Experience leading Salesforce implementation initiatives

• Strong communication skills with ability to translate business needs and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical staff

• Required Certification: Salesforce Certified Administrator

title: National Sales Manager, Professional Development
description:
ABOUT ZERO TO THREE

Founded in 1977, ZERO TO THREE works to ensure that babies and toddlers benefit from the early connections that are critical to their well-being and development. Our mission is to ensure that all babies and toddlers have a strong start in life. At ZERO TO THREE , we envision a society with the knowledge and will to support all infants and toddlers in reaching their full potential. Our Core Values Statement: We believe that how we do our work is as important as what we do. To learn more about ZERO TO THREE , please visit our website at zerotothree.org.

SUMMARY

The Professional Innovations team is focused on delivering cutting-edge training and resources that advance the knowledge and skills of early childhood professionals across diverse sectors, from education and healthcare to early intervention services and child welfare. As National Sales Manager, Professional Development, you will serve as the organization's lead sales professional, personally selling ZERO TO THREE 's full suite of professional development products and services to prospective and established clients nationwide. You will develop and execute effective sales strategies and identify, direct, build and manage a robust opportunity pipeline, and use a collaborative, consultative approach to grow revenue and expand market share. In addition to driving direct sales, you will play a key role in shoring up the team's sales infrastructure, including but not limited to strengthening pipeline tracking and Salesforce practices, sharpening processes, and providing guidance to other sales team members to build a stronger foundation for sustained growth Building upon an existing foundation of established success in the marketplace, your work will combine hands-on selling with the systems/infrastructure and support that enable the broader team's success.
ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

• Serve as the organization's lead sales professional, personally driving the sale of ZERO TO THREE 's full suite of professional development (PD) products and services directly to prospective and established clients.

• Meet or exceed individual sales targets and contribute to team and organizational revenue goals through hands-on prospecting, pitching, and closing.

• Craft and execute effective sales strategies using a consultative approach, building strong relationships with clients through direct outreach, presentations, and negotiations.

• Strategically and creatively manage a personal opportunity pipeline from prospect through close.

title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
description:
Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer-from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems , we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond-all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. We are developers, designers, and researchers who have contributed in academia, open-source communities, policymaking, and beyond. We have raised roughly $60 million from leading investors in technology and crypto, including a16z, Greylock Partners, Electric Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Polychain Capital.
As a Systems Software Engineer, you will closely collaborate with fellow engineers and product managers to make Espresso a reality. Your focus will be on the transaction processing, communication, consensus, and storage components of the ledger and roll-up systems, while using the cryptography library developed by our cryptography team.
Responsibilities

• Contribute to the design and implementation of Espresso’s core blockchain infrastructure in Rust

• Take engineering projects from concept and design to production, while working with engineering leaders and the product team to create sound and realistic roadmaps

Requirements

• B.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics, or relevant field, or equivalent computer science and software engineering experience

• Experience shipping and taking engineering projects to production

• Experience with distributed systems and/or blockchain systems, especially P2P networking and consensus

• Understanding of software engineering and security best practices

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Passion for writing correct code

Preferred

• Proficiency with Rust in a production environment (or similar strongly-typed languages such as C++, Haskell, Ocaml, etc.)

• Experience working on blockchain infrastructure, e.g. a layer-1 blockchain

• Enthusiasm for the rapidly developing blockchain ecosystem

Benefits

You'll own the product roadmap for the client's document intelligence platform. What you'll do

• Own the roadmap and priorities across data engineering, data science, backend, search and frontend teams

• Turn business needs into requirements, user stories, business rules and measurable acceptance criteria

• A track record of discovery driven by prototypes or demos

• Skill turning business needs into detailed, technical, testable requirements

• Experience defining acceptance criteria for probabilistic features such as model outputs, alerts, recommendations or rankings

• Close working experience with data scientists, data engineers, software engineers and UX

• Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, writing and decision-making

Requirements

• Authorized to work in the US, with 3+ consecutive years living in the US

Nice to have

• Document intelligence, OCR, semantic or vector search, generative AI, or human-in-the-loop workflows

Our team, composed of former public health officials, works with state and local health departments across the country, building resilient public health operating systems. We pride ourselves on being different, holding ourselves to high ethical standards, and taking care of each other.

We view our company as an urban neighborhood-a diverse group of individuals coming together to live and work, embracing the beauty in that diversity. • Focus on Capacity Building

• Belief in Continuous Experimentation

• We Do What Is Right. Always.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A TEAM MEMBER WITH PUBLIC HEALTH EXPERIENCE (LOCAL/ TRIBAL/ STATE/ FEDERAL).

About Consulting at F&T Labs

If you're new to consulting, we want to help you understand what makes F&T Labs different and why our approach might be perfect for you. We know transitioning from government and non-profit to consulting can be a big step, but we've designed our work environment to blend the best of both worlds.

First, let's talk about how we work. Unlike traditional consulting firms, we hire you for a role, not a specific project. This means you can contribute to various initiatives that match your expertise and interests. Think of it as bringing your public health superpowers to different challenges where they're needed most.

We believe in measuring what matters. While many consulting firms focus on billable hours, we care about the quality and impact of your work. Time sheets don't measure your success with us - it's measured by the meaningful solutions you help create for our clients and their communities.

Yes, we have utilization targets (consulting speak for how much of your time is spent on client work), but we view these as guideposts rather than strict rules. They help us ensure we're making a sustainable impact while maintaining a healthy business. These targets are meant to motivate, not to create stress.

One of the most dynamic aspects of consulting is its natural rhythm. Some weeks might be bustling with activity, while others might be quieter. We embrace these ebbs and flows because they create space for both intense, focused work and time for learning, reflection, and personal growth. This is part of our philosophy that work and life shouldn't be at odds - they should be integrated in a sustainable and energizing way.

At our core, we're built on a simple belief: when our team members flourish, our clients flourish, and ultimately, communities thrive. That's why we've created an environment that supports your growth, values your expertise, and understands that the best solutions come from people who feel empowered and energized by their work.

If you're passionate about public health and excited about the possibility of expanding your impact through consulting, we'd love to talk with you. Your experience in public health is valuable, and we're here to help you apply it in new and meaningful ways.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Strategic Defense

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategic Defense team at Anduril protects the United States and its allies from ballistic, hypersonic, and air-breathing threats. Those threats now arrive in seconds, maneuver mid-flight, and come in volleys designed to overwhelm the legacy systems meant to stop them - so we're building a software-defined command and control layer that can see, decide, and act faster than any human operator could alone. Our team spans autonomy, tracking, simulation and wargaming, hardware, systems engineering, and test and evaluation to build an accredited fire control system fielded rapidly and at scale. We are at the forefront of incubating and maturing AI-native offerings for the integrated air and missile defense domain.

ABOUT THE JOB

This application is for established coders with 8+ years of experience who will breeze through live coding interviews and it does not require active clearance but you must be eligible. 

As a Software Engineer in Strategic Defense, you will write code side-by-side with elite peers to solve a wide variety of problems involving networking, autonomy, systems integration, robotics, and more. You’ll make pragmatic engineering tradeoffs along the way to ensure Anduril products achieve a variety of desired outcomes in ambiguous situations where more is on the line than money or corporate gains. Tiugo is the company behind CKEditor, TinyMCE, Uploadcare and ButterCMS, developer tools that power rich content creation inside thousands of applications and across the Fortune 1000. Formed in 2021 and backed by PSG, we have grown through acquisition into a ~$60M ARR business with strong gross and net retention and Rule of 60 performance.

Why this role exists now
Over the next eighteen months we are layering an enterprise, AI-led motion on top of an inbound Sales Assist motion and a product-led engine, across four brands with four histories and four stacks. That demands a revenue operations function that designs the engine rather than maintains it. One that owns how a customer moves from first touch through renewal, how we measure it, how we equip the field to run it, and how we automate the parts that should not need a human. The clearest example is renewals: moving the long tail to a tech-touch motion where people manage by exception, designed hand in hand with our Customer Success leaders. • Planning and performance cadence. Territory and coverage design, quota setting, capacity and productivity modeling, and the forecast process and its discipline. You design the incentive plans; Finance administers and pays them.

• Deal desk. It also brings together the sales support work that keeps deals moving, such as quoting. Finance and Legal keep their approval authority; this role owns the path to it. You will define how the function operates as part of building it.

• Field enablement. Onboarding and ramp, sales methodology, and product and AI fluency across the field. This is a build rather than a maintain, and you will hire the leader for it.

• GTM engineering and applied AI. In collaboration with a central AI team, own Revenue Organization automation across the revenue lifecycle and internal AI applications pointed at go-to-market work.

• Business analysis for the revenue engine. Not report production, but interpretation. Monitoring what the business is actually doing, diagnosing what changed and why, and turning that into recommendations the revenue leadership team acts on. Senior People Partner

📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 4 days WFH) | 💰 £60,000 - £70,000

Street Group is a fast moving B2B SaaS business - grown in Manchester but on a UK wide mission to make moving house as easy as buying a car. We’ve recently raised strategic growth investment, and are scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan - and we’re looking for a Senior People Partner to ensure we get there.

Over the past 6 years, our People team has designed, built, and implemented the people processes that have scaled Street Group from 30 - 230 people. But we know that systems that work at 200 people can break when growth accelerates - and we want to get ahead of that.

This is an opportunity for someone who has been through that scaling journey before to have an oversized impact on a small but ambitious People team to become best in class.

If you know what can impact culture both positively and negatively as a company grows; have experience building systems that both set people up to do their best work AND that scale alongside the business; and embrace AI and the positive impact it can have on employee experience - we think you might do great work here.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS NOW

Our People team is lean - and as we mature as a business, there’s limited capacity to ensure we’re constantly innovating and improving the mechanisms that enable people to do their best work. We have ambitious goals to achieve - now is the time to fine-tune our People function to ensure the business hits those goals.

THE ROLE

In 2026, over half of the business told us they don't know what excellence looks like in their role, or how excellence is rewarded. This is the crux of this role; to build the systems, processes and reward that sets people up for success and ensure we reward and retain our best people.

Over the next 12-18 months, this will mean you'll be working with our Head of People and People Partner on initiatives that clarify excellence and reward - our internal levels framework, compensation & reward, embedding our excellence standard throughout the business, coaching senior managers and leaders, and building manager capability at scale.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- A Senior People Partner with experience operating at this level: you’ve designed people systems built for growth, coached senior managers and leaders, are curious about how technology and innovation is changing the People landscape, and are constantly looking for more impactful ways to support the business.

- A commercial mindset - e.g. you measure your results on impact on business and team performance rather than work shipped.

- An AI-native mindset: you treat AI as leverage and are keen to learn from our team, and share what’s been working for you - but understand the nuances of where AI can never replace genuine People Partnering.

- The credibility and communication skills to bring busy managers on the journey with you.

- Someone who makes the team better on purpose, not by accident: you share what you know and help develop the people around you.

WHY YOU MIGHT NOT WANT TO APPLY

We'd rather be honest up front, because this role won’t be for everyone.

- If you want to move into people management. This is a senior IC role. You'll coach, share knowledge, and set standards, but you won't have direct reports. If a management title is what you're chasing now or in the imminent future, this isn’t the job for you.

- If you haven't been through a similar scaling journey in SaaS businesses before. Our People team is home grown; we're specifically looking for the experience and knowledge that comes from having been there/done that before, and can prevent us from making common mistakes.

- If AI feels like a threat rather than a tool. We love Claude Cowork, and have both built and used multiple other tools to improve and speed up our ways of working. We have a company-wide expectation that AI is utilised, so it will be a large part of this role.

Fivetran and dbt Labs are coming together with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Product Finance covers two things: how our products perform, and what they cost to build, run, and support. This role owns the cost and investment side, as the finance partner to the Product and Customer Support organizations.

title: Senior Software Developer, Dataplane Adapters
description:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model - it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.
Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide - including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more - have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.
So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology-and your hard work!
About the Role
We at Solace believe we build the world's best event broker - the backbone of real-time business, trusted to move billions of messages a day across cloud, on-premises, and edge environments with unmatched reliability and performance.
At the heart of the Solace Event Broker lies the Datapath - the engine responsible for moving messages at high rate, with low latency and utmost reliability. The Dataplane Adapters team owns the protocol surface: the MQTT, AMQP, REST, RDP, and Kafka adapters that let clients and applications connect, publish, and consume messages. This work spans our custom hardware appliance - built around FPGAs and a Cavium network processor - and our software broker running on Intel server processors. The code is highly multi-threaded and performance-oriented, and our developers regularly go deep into TCP, hardware interfaces, and OS internals to deliver features that meet our strict performance and reliability bar.
This position is for a Senior Software Developer on the Dataplane Adapters team. In this role you will be a key technical leader who contributes to the architecture of our protocol adapters and leads the design and delivery of the most complex features for how clients connect to the broker. You will shape technical direction across the hardware and software platforms, mentor other developers, represent the team with customers and other R&D groups, and be a go-to person for the hardest performance and field problems. Your expertise will shape how the world's largest enterprises move their most critical data.
Are You Someone Who:

• Has a passion for high-performance systems with a deep understanding of multi-threaded C++, TCP/IP, and the Linux kernel?

• Thrives on solving complex protocol and performance challenges in distributed messaging systems?

• Has experience building high-throughput, low-latency systems?

• Enjoys mentoring and leading technical teams while contributing to architectural decisions?

• Values craftsmanship, collaboration, and delivering exceptional customer experiences?

• Is humble, honest and open?

What You'll Do:

• Lead Adapter Design: Contribute to the architecture of our protocol adapters, lead the design and technical delivery of the most complex features across the hardware appliance and software broker, and own the technical decisions within those features

• Drive Technical Innovation: Research and prototype new protocol features, networking techniques, and performance approaches to keep the Solace datapath ahead of the industry

• Develop Core Platform Features: Design and build the most complex, performance-critical adapter features in multi-threaded C++, going deep into TCP, hardware interfaces, and OS internals when needed

• Mentor and Lead: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to intermediate and junior developers, lead design and code reviews, and establish best practices for the team, including how we use AI-assisted development in performance-critical code

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with product management,

We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

title: Senior Software Engineer III, Email & Communications Platform
description:
Senior Software Engineer, Email & Communications Platform (Software Engineer III)
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team that owns our email and communications platform - the system responsible for delivering millions of marketing emails on behalf of our dealer network. You'll work across the full stack, building and scaling the infrastructure that powers campaigns, transactional messages, and automated communications that directly drive revenue for our customers.
This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership. Our platform is in an active modernization phase. You'll be working in a mature codebase that serves real production traffic while incrementally upgrading architecture, tooling, and patterns. That means you need to be comfortable holding two things at once: keeping the lights on for a system dealers depend on today, and making deliberate progress toward where the platform needs to be tomorrow. You'll design and implement features end-to-end, from database schema and API design through to the UI that internal teams and dealers interact with, while identifying opportunities to retire technical debt and modernize along the way.
You'll tackle challenges around deliverability, throughput, sender reputation, and compliance - problems where good engineering decisions have measurable business impact. You'll collaborate closely with product, deliverability specialists, and other engineering teams. We're a remote-first team that values clear communication, pragmatic technical decisions, and shipping work that matters.

• Design, build, and maintain full-stack features across our email and communications platform

• Balance new feature development with incremental improvements to system reliability, maintainability, and developer experience

At FMX , our Engineering Managers have a direct impact on our product, our people, and our culture. As manager of a Core Team, you’ll coach and mentor a talented group of software engineers, give them clarity on priorities and expectations, and help them grow technically and professionally while delivering high-quality software for our customers. You’ll partner closely with product, design, QA, and other engineering leaders to align your team’s work with business goals and build a healthy, high-performing, inclusive engineering culture.
This is a player-coach role. We want a manager who still loves to build: someone who stays close to the code, picks up bugs and non-mission-critical work alongside the team, and leads by example. Lead and grow your team: Give every engineer clarity on their role, responsibilities, goals, and the team’s processes, and clearly communicate changes to practices, priorities, and expectations. •

•
Clear the path: Actively remove blockers so the team works efficiently with minimal friction.

Stay technical: Keep a strong understanding of your team’s systems so you can guide architecture decisions and unblock engineers directly. Champion operational excellence, including observability, CI/CD health, and production readiness.

•

• 2-4 years of engineering management or technical leadership experience, and prior experience as a software engineer, ideally in SaaS.

• A proven ability to coach and grow engineers at every career stage, with strong, empathetic, and clear communication.

• Experience improving engineering processes and development workflows, plus familiarity with agile practices and cross-functional collaboration.

• The ability to think strategically while attending to the details of day-to-day execution.

• A passion for building inclusive, psychologically safe teams that value continuous learning and an excellent developer experience.

• Enthusiasm for FMX ’s mission and alignment with our core pillars: Teamwork, Excellence, and Integrity.

title: Director, Enterprise Quality Engineering and Agentic Evaluation
description:
Company Description
Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.
We are seeking an experienced Director, Enterprise Quality Engineering and Agentic Evaluation to build and lead a modern enterprise quality capability across Zayo’s technology organization. This role will be accountable for improving the reliability, predictability, and speed of technology delivery while providing independent assurance for critical business platforms, transformational programs, and AI-enabled solutions.
The successful candidate will combine deep quality engineering expertise with strong enterprise leadership, bringing a risk-based, automation-first approach to how quality is embedded across the software delivery lifecycle. The role will also shape how Zayo evaluates and governs emerging agentic AI capabilities, ensuring they are reliable, controlled, and ready for enterprise-scale adoption.

This is a highly collaborative and transformational leadership role, partnering across Engineering, Product, Architecture, Data and AI, Operations, and business teams to strengthen quality outcomes, reduce production risk, and establish a culture of measurable engineering excellence.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and lead Zayo’s enterprise quality engineering strategy, operating model, roadmap, service catalog, standards, and governance.

• Own the enterprise quality engineering platform, including Tosca, qTest, automation assets, integrations, test execution infrastructure, quality reporting, and AI-evaluation capabilities.

• Establish risk-based quality models, release-readiness criteria, quality gates, certification standards, and evidence requirements for critical platforms, business processes, integrations, data products, and AI agents.

• Lead a centralized quality engineering service that plans, automates, executes, and governs testing across enterprise products, platforms, programs, and high-risk releases.

• Develop reusable automation frameworks, model-based testing patterns, API and integration testing capabilities, regression suites, and continuous testing practices aligned to business risk and production impact.

• Establish enterprise capabilities for AI-agent evaluation, including scenario design, evaluation datasets, regression testing, tool-use validation, policy and permission checks, human escalation criteria, and production quality monitoring.

• Own the enterprise approach to test data, test environments, service virtualization, production validation, and quality analytics to reduce release risk and delivery delays.

• Provide independent quality intelligence and release-risk assessments to engineering, product, program, and executive stakeholders.

• Manage vendor-outsourced quality engineering resources, Tricentis partners, systems integrators, and specialist testing providers to deliver sustained enterprise quality outcomes.

• Build a quality engineering culture focused on automation, objective assurance, reuse, engineering discipline, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

• Minimum of twelve (12) years of experience in quality engineering, software testing, test automation, platform engineering, enterprise technology delivery, or related technology disciplines, including 5+ years leading quality engineering, test automation, enterprise testing, or platform-or

title: Account Manager, Paid Search
description:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

The Account Manager, Paid Media is responsible for Paid Media performance, along with client management and delegation of production resources. They serve as the primary point of contact for their assigned clients by answering client emails and leading weekly calls. They also design and execute Paid Media channel strategy. The Account Manager will work with vendor reps and senior team members to hone the strategies they present to clients but are ultimately responsible for project management on accounts they own.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES 

• Maintaining an advanced understanding of primary paid media channels and how they fit within the funnel - to include Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Apple Search Ads, etc.

• Driving account strategy geared towards achieving or exceeding client efficiency and growth goals.

• Developing and executing the appropriate account management monitoring and optimization techniques to drive performance toward client targets and budgets.

• Quantifying and prioritizing initiatives that will have the greatest impact on account performance.

• Driving the creation of client roadmaps, testing plans, reports/dashboards, and QBRs/FBRs to meet client needs.

• Managing the performance of designated client portfolio to client performance goals and practicing good stewardship of client budgets.

• Writing, reviewing and ensuring that agendas meet client needs for status calls and adhere to all important and upcoming management updates.

• Effectively leading client calls, speaking to completed projects, performance, and planned initiatives/long-term optimization strategy.

• Ensuring all account management efforts go through a QA process and are executed/delivered error-free.

• Owning the relationship between DEPT® and dedicated platform reps (i.e. Google, LinkedIn, etc.). Working with reps to identify and vet new opportunities while maintaining platform best practices, etc.

• Owning the paid media strategic roadmap on all accounts and supporting the Account Lead to help in coordinating initiatives with growth teams for the holistic client roadmap.

QUALIFICATIONS

• A minimum of 3 years of Paid Media experience and comfort with topics such as budgeting, bidding, and testing methodology

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

Additional things that will impress us:

• You are an energetic and creative marketing enthusiast; eager to roll up your sleeves and be hands on, learn, and grow in the marketing space.

• You are entrepreneurial spirited and a self-starter; able to work both independently and in a team environment

 

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage

• 401K plan, plus matching

title: Patient Consent Coordinator
description:
Patient Consent Coordinator
Overview
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a Patient Consent Coordinator. Our client is a US-based healthcare organization that coordinates genetic testing services for patients across the country. In this role, you will serve as a key point of contact between the client and patients, reaching out by phone after a physician has ordered genetic testing, guiding patients through the consent process with clarity and care, and ensuring all records are accurately maintained in the client's portal.
This is a fully remote, phone-based position requiring a high level of professionalism, patience, and attention to detail. You will work standard US Eastern Standard Time (EST) business hours and must be comfortable managing sensitive patient conversations with empathy and discretion.
Key Responsibilities

• Contact patients by phone following a physician's referral for genetic testing to explain the consent process and address any questions

• Obtain verbal or documented patient consent in accordance with the client's established protocols

• Conduct follow-up calls with patients who were unreachable or require additional information before consenting

• Accurately log all patient interactions, consent status updates, and follow-up notes into the client's online portal

• Maintain organized records and flag any incomplete or outstanding consent cases for timely resolution

• Communicate professionally with patients of varying backgrounds, adapting tone and language to ensure clarity and comfort

• Adhere to patient confidentiality standards and handle all sensitive information with discretion

Requirements

• Matric (Grade 12) as a minimum qualification; a National Diploma or relevant NQF Level 6 qualification in Healthcare Administration, Health Sciences, or a related field is advantageous

• At least 1-2 years of experience in a patient-facing, customer service, or administrative role

• Excellent spoken and written English communication skills, with a clear and professional telephone manner

• Reliable, high-speed internet connection and a quiet, dedicated home workspace suitable for confidential patient calls

• Ability to work US Eastern Standard Time (EST) business hours on a consistent basis

• Computer literacy with the ability to navigate online portals and CRM or case management systems accurately

Preferred Experience

• Prior experience in a healthcare, medical administration, or clinical support environment

• Experience conducting outbound calls in a structured or scripted environment, such as a call center or patient coordination role

• Familiarity with medical terminology, particularly relating to diagnostics or laboratory services

• Experience handling sensitive or confidential information in a regulated or compliance-aware setting

Key Competencies
* Strong communication skills
* High attention to detail
* Strong organizational skills
* Ability to work independently
* Professionalism and reliability

Join the team as Twilio’s next Machine Learning Engineer, Customer Memory.

About the job

This position is needed to build and scale the pipelines that turn raw conversation data into structured, searchable customer memory, and the evaluation systems that keep that memory accurate as the product evolves.

You'll join the Conversation Memory team, which builds the memory layer behind Twilio's Conversational AI platform: the systems that extract what matters from millions of conversations, resolve it to the right customer, and retrieve it in milliseconds when an agent needs it. Memory that is wrong, stale, or crossed between customers is worse than no memory at all, so quality measurement is a first-class part of the work.

• Contribute to the eval systems that tell us whether memory is actually getting better, turning a fuzzy question of quality into benchmarks and regression gates that run before every change ships.

• Diagnose production issues across the ingestion, extraction, and indexing path using logs, metrics, and traces.

• Partner with Product and ML teams to translate customer problems into system changes and evaluation criteria.

title: [US - DC] FSQ Area Manager
Autism & ADHD Assessor for Children
description:
Time commitment: Between 3-5 days per week (0.6-1 FTE) - our preference is for this to be an Employed position, but we will also consider Self-employed arrangements
Location: Remote
Reporting to: NeurodevelopmentalTeam Manager
About Paloma
In 2024, our founders, Mark and Darshak, were shocked to find that children needing an NHS autism or ADHD assessment were waiting 4-10 years for these assessments. Delayed assessments result in children being more likely to develop mental health conditions and fall behind in education. Furthermore, the much-needed pre/post-assessment support (outside of ADHD medications) is typically not funded by the NHS.
These long waits have built up due to increased recognition and understanding of neurodevelopmental conditions and a lack of investment and innovation within the NHS to meet the growing demand.
Mark and Darshak, with their 25 years of combined NHS experience, including building services that have treated over 1,000,000 patients in obesity & ophthalmology, founded Paloma to change this. Our mission is to make NHS autism and ADHD assessments and care accessible within 4 weeks of a GP referral, and, in turn, help every child achieve their potential.
As of May 2026, we have successfully reduced waits to 3 months by;

• Taking a product-first approach to redesign the care pathway to give families a more consumer-like experience of care

• Our in-house product, engineering and AI team building our own autism and ADHD specific electronic patient record and AI documentation tool to free clinicians from their significant documentation burden to re-focus on supporting families

• Investing in expanding the clinician workforce and upskilling them in new ways of working.

We are proud that Paloma is:

• Loved by families, with 4.9 out of 5 Trustpilot and Google ratings

• Care Quality Commission (CQC) registered and quality-focused

• Clinically-led, with a team of 130 people, including over 80 clinicians supporting families through their assessment journey. We are hiring 100+ more roles over the next 12 months.

• A community of passionate, mission-driven and innovative team members who challenge the status quo and test and learn from new ideas and approaches.

• Backed by leading healthcare investors Triple Point and Heal Capital

What’s next?

• Whilst we have reduced wait times, it is estimated that up to 500,000 children are still waiting for an NHS autism or ADHD assessment. We won’t rest until this comes down.

• We want to build new services to support families and children diagnosed with autism or ADHD who feel lost after their assessments when the NHS is no longer there for them.

The Opportunity
Are you an innovative clinician working in children’s autism and ADHD assessments, excited to use software tools that enhance the prescriber and patient experience of care? This role is for you!
We are not a standard autism and ADHD assessment service; we:

• Have built our own technology & AI tools to gather the required information from families, and support your documentation, so you can focus on children’s needs

• Have a Clinical Specialist, who is a senior clinician who works alongside you to ensure all of our assessments are multidisciplinary in line with NICE guidance.

• Offer an integrated ADHD prescribing service led by our Prescribing Team, ensuring families can get fast access to ADHD medications where required

This role will ensure we deliver a fantastic Children’s Autism and ADHD assessment service to families.
We commit to supporting your development and well-being, including:

• The Paloma Clinical Academy programme supports all clinicians at all stages of their careers to develop (e.g. to our Senior Assessor role) and cross-skill (e.g. in autism)

• Regular clinical supervision

• 1 protected day per month for assessor team training, Continuing Professional Development (CPD), and reflection.

• Quarterly development conversations with clear career progression pathways.
